The persistent hydration warning is produced by KnowledgePanels Access-grants `grant-user-select` option rendering (people.map -> pattern via Field helper).
rca of the issue: Hydration warning RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/KnowledgePanels.js the VaultGrants form uses a shared Field/Select helper that wraps dynamic text in a <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>. When mapped inside <option> for the grant-user-select, React emits 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Fix is to render the user name as a plain text child (e.g., {u.name}) directly inside <option>, bypassing the span wrapper. Does not affect behavior but shows in every console session.
